Hi team,

Following our QBR asks from Acme (Sarah P.), they want a per-route cost breakdown that also factors in SLO buckets (p95 < 200ms, p95 200-500ms, degraded >500ms) so they can tie spend to business impact. Sales needs something to show finance for negotiations and to scope an exception for their reserved capacity billing.

Attached is a first-pass model (slo_cost_model_v2.xlsx) that maps token/time breakdowns -> unit cost by SLO tier and a quick Figma preview (figma-screens-quick.png). Ask: can Product & Analytics scope a dashboard that surfaces:
- per-route daily cost and token volume
- SLO bucketed latency distribution per-route
- per-tenant chargeback preview (estimated monthly)
- flagging rows where we’d recommend a negotiated SLA/credit (rule-based)

Timing: Acme wants a mock for their finance review the week of July 13. Not expecting GA — a strong mock + sanity numbers will do.

Marissa

Thanks Marissa — good framing. A few quick engineering notes before we commit: 
1) Metric availability: we already emit per-request latency and token counts, but per-route aggregation for historic SLO slices (p50/p95/p99 by route per-tenant) is only indexed for 90 days in the analytics pipeline. If Acme needs 12mo lookback for finance, we’ll need an ETL.
2) Cost model granularity: the model assumes uniform GPU token cost per-minute; we have known variance across models and quantization — need to either surface a per-model modifier or normalize to a representative SKU.
3) Implementation approach: I propose a mock using existing metrics + simulated cost multipliers (low engineering lift) and a follow-up JIRA to add persistent per-tenant SLO buckets if they green-light.

Action: I’ll prototype mock queries and a small dashboard slice by next Tue (Jun 30). Can Product confirm the list of priority routes and whether we should include function/tool call costs separately?

—Karthik
Senior SW Eng, Serving Runtime

Appreciate the example Marissa. A few commercial constraints from my side: 
- Acme is asking for per-route estimated billing showing both Hosted usage and any Reserved capacity offsets (they want to see how credits would be applied).
- For enterprise deals we sometimes grant a one-off SLO credit for the first 3 months if the historic p95 is > target. Need the dashboard to indicate when that rule would trigger and the estimated credit amount (simple multiplier is fine).

Also, include a toggle to switch between "example pricing" and "account-specific pricing" (since rates differ by reserved vs hosted). If we can show a mock with Acme's current seat of 1.2M tokens/mo and two heavy routes ("/chat/standard", "/chat/summary"), that’ll be enough for their finance team.

Noted. I can coordinate Product & Analytics on the delivery plan. A few notes for the plan doc:
- Risk: per-tenant historical SLO buckets require changes to retention/aggregation. Mitigation: show 90d live buckets + simulated 12mo extrapolation for the mock.
- Risk: mixing reserved credit math with hosted spend has edge cases (multi-model mixes). Mitigation: include a simple "assumptions" panel in the mock and surface model-level multipliers if available.
- Owner suggestions: Product PM (TBD) to own UX + validation, Analytics to deliver queries (Karthik prototype), Marissa as customer proxy for acceptance.

I’ll draft the plan and circulate by EOD Fri.
